title.zh: 卷积神经网络的特征图 · 小窗口怎样“看”图
title.en: CNN Feature Maps · How a Small Window “Sees” an Image

desc.zh: 一个 3×3 的小窗口在图上滑动，边缘、模糊、锐化各是一组数字；把它们堆起来，再让机器自己学出这组数字。
desc.en: A 3×3 window slides across an image; edges, blur and sharpening are just different sets of nine numbers. Stack them, then let the machine learn the numbers itself.
